transformer_layer: The repeated layers mix tokens through an attention mechanism over a sequence (softmax attention or a variant), each with its own FFN, two normalizations, and two residual additions — every repeated layer is a transformer layer slot. The slot facts must be extractable from the prepared model and uniform across the stack: num_heads, head_dim, ffn_dim (FFN intermediate width), max_seq_len (real input sequence length), activation, and the residual stream width. A model whose slot facts are missing, guessed, or non-uniform across layers is unsupported: classify it 'No supported match' and fail loud before any supernet code is generated — a variant branch built from a wrong or default-guessed fact silently mis-parameterizes the branch. Convolutional feature mixing as the primary mechanism, and any stack whose layer facts cannot be measured, are unsupported.
